description:
Get YouTube Channel Data

Fetches a YouTube channel by its ID (`UC…`) or handle (`@name`) and returns structured data for any channel tab — `featured`/Home, `videos`, `shorts`, `streams`, `playlists`, `posts`, `podcasts`, `releases`, `store` (desktop only), `about`. Returns channel identity (title, description, avatar, banner), subscriber count, country, join date, total-view count and social links (on the `about` tab), and the items on the requested tab (videos with views and publish date, playlists, posts, podcasts, etc.). Use to monitor competitor channels, build creator/brand directories, track posting cadence and growth signals, or feed `videoId` into the YouTube Video / Transcript endpoints.

channelId.description: YouTube channel identifier — either the canonical channel ID (`UC…`, 24 chars) or the public handle starting with `@` (e.g. `@PewDiePie`). Legacy `/c/<custom>` and `/user/<name>` URL slugs are also accepted.

gl.description: The two-letter country code for the country you want to limit the search to. Provide one exact documented value (245 allowed), e.g. `ac`, `af`.

hl.description: The two-letter language code for the language you want to use for the search. Provide one exact documented value (159 allowed), e.g. `af`, `ak`.

paginationToken.description: Token returned in the previous response to fetch the next page of results.

tab.description:
Channel tab to scrape. Each tab returns a different content shape:
- `featured` (default) — channel Home page (channel trailer + curated rows)
- `videos` — uploaded long-form videos
- `shorts` — Shorts feed
- `streams` — past and upcoming live streams
- `playlists` — created and saved playlists
- `posts` / `community` — community posts
- `podcasts` — podcast episodes
- `releases` — music releases
- `about` — channel description, links, stats
- `store` — channel merch
